environment_policy: Owner Keep assets active with exact hashes. Reject candidates excluded; earlier kit or procedural fallback. No new generation.

environment_gaps.industrial: Earlier tyres, drum, sign and crate replace rejected tyre wall, stacks, hoarding and wreck.
environment_gaps.quarry: Earlier rock field and crates replace the crane, quarry face, slag and wreck; no distinct crane silhouette.
environment_gaps.desert: No salt-crust or retained dune sprite. Earlier brush/sign/crate and kept pylon share the smaller set; procedural ground remains.
environment_gaps.wetland: Earlier crate, tree, drum and tyres replace rejected sluice, stacks and tyre wall.
environment_gaps.alpine: Earlier sign, rocks, brush, tyres and crate replace rejected rail, rock fall, spire, scattered tyres and wreck.
